name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause uses a Response template on the persistent condition siren_ringing, causing the machine to require toggling the switch on every step while the siren is on. The task, however, refers to the event of the siren starting to ring, and only requires the switch to be toggled once per ring start. The clause should target the siren start event (or be rephrased so that the toggle is required only when the siren begins ringing, not on each subsequent step).

texts: Whenever the siren starts ringing, toggle the siren switch.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !siren_ringing&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, siren_ringing&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u2, switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -1
(u2, switch_toggled, u1) -> 1
